t: Free software that prepares designs and sends jobs to laser cutters.
steps: Check that your laser cutter is supported. Models include Epilog ZING, MINI, and HELIX and cutters with the LAOS board.
Ask IT to install it and set up Java.
Configure the laser cutter driver and the network or USB connection.
Load a simple SVG and preview it on the material.
Set up safety rules for laser use.
Run a first test cut with a teacher present.
